title: 第十一章 定身符第十二章 哇哈哈
content_zh:
师春亦跳起拔刀，快速冲去，前者刀太重，不多时被他追过。
两人冲出来后的毫不掩饰，加之踩的石砾哗啦啦的动静，顿令前面几人陆续回头。
吴斤两的个子，还有吴斤两的刀，都太明显了，哪怕看不清面容，申尤昆也一眼认出了是谁，当即没忍住惊呼，“是师春和吴斤两，快跑，快跑！”
他真的有些慌了。
竟是那两位？祁自如也是一脸讶异，原以为那两人已经跑了，没想到竟又窝在了他眼皮子底下等机会，大概也猜到了师春二人趁机杀出的意图，真正由衷而赞，“好胆！好手段！既有客来访，岂能拒而不见，停轿，会客。”
两名轿夫停止了奔跑，调转方向落轿，守在了轿子左右。
蒙面大汉也停下了，同时松开了挣扎的申尤昆。
申尤昆竟吓得滚下了小山坡，连滚带爬地仓惶而逃，边跑边不时回头看，脸都吓变了色，显然不认为这边几个是师春他们的对手。
见到追击目标竟停在了小山坡上恭候，师春也察觉到了一些不对劲，然申尤昆吓得落荒而逃的样子又不像是演的，顿释疑不少，呼啦啦全速不停，冲到了对手跟前，借势跳起，腾空就是一刀，瓢泼寒光当空劈下，狠且果断！
两名轿夫挡在了祁自如身前准备应战，蒙面大汉却静候不动，竟不管师春劈来的一刀，而是盯向了吴斤两。
吴斤两也已冲来，哇哇叫地兴奋大喊，“吃我一刀！”
那大刀挥出的呜呜破风声吓人。
等到他也近了些，蒙面大汉终于出手了，双手一抖，在月色下弹出了两道黄色影子，一道射向了师春，一道射向了吴斤两。
师春刀锋凌空一偏，欲劈开射来之物，眼前却陡然晃出一股眩晕感。
怎么回事？暗自心惊，紧急定神的他发现不是眩晕，而是眼前虚空波荡出了一股扭曲感，同时也感觉到冥冥中有一股迟滞之力笼罩其身。
他发现自己狠冲强劈的攻击动作居然变成了慢动作，斩出的刀锋慢了，错过了那道飞射而至的黄影，近距离之下他看清了，竟是一道黄皮纸符，上面布有朱红色的繁复符文。
视线下垂，眼睁睁看着那道符文贴在了自己的胸前。
他动作迟缓，想躲避都来不及，隐约感受到符文中似有一股莫名力量在释放，然后他便无法动弹了。
人并未落地，而是定在了空中，还保持着刀劈的动作。
人虽不能动，脑子却是清晰的，瞬间意识到了是怎么回事，定身符！

竟遭遇上了传说中的定身符！
对他来说就是传说，以前没见过，只听说外界有这玩意，没想到眼前这伙人居然连这玩意都弄进来了。
此刻可谓悔青了肠子，恨自己见识短，也不想想，人家连那么多物资都能弄进来，弄张符箓进来很难吗？自己跑都跑了，还兜回来，这不是撞上门的找死么。
想到被申尤昆逃跑的行为打了眼，他心里在问候申尤昆祖宗。
不过也从吓得逃跑的申尤昆身上看出来了，这绝不是申尤昆的手笔，申尤昆甚至有可能都不知道，应该是躺椅上从容淡定那位的手笔。
后面的吴斤两也没了动静，也被定在了那，眼中有惊恐神色，嘴巴还张着，清楚意识到自己这次是真的栽了，死倒没什么，玩命的那天开始就知道自己迟早会有这天，就怕会受尽折磨不得好死。
他想说话也说不出来，嘴里只能发出含糊不清的“呜呜”声，想问师春怎么办。
他知道师春恐怕也没什么好办法，可眼下他除了找师春想办法还能找谁？
逃跑中不时回头的申尤昆停下了，认真查看后，似乎明白了点什么，难怪舅舅说什么就算是高武境界也跑不了，原来是这样，顿又一脸狞笑地往回跑。
这一幕，师春看到了，他被定住了，眼睛却不瞎，眼皮子想闭也闭不上，深知申尤昆必然要报仇雪恨。
他落谁手里都不想落申尤昆手里，遂拼尽全部修为抗争，意图挣脱束缚，然开始还能撼动些将其定身的力量，之后便如同被浇筑在了钢铁中一般，倒也没多大压迫感，就是无法动摇分毫。
更恐怖的是，连一身的法力都被定住了一般，无法施展到体外作为。
也算混在修行界多年，对他经历的打打杀杀来说，就是个人修为实力的硬拼，对上这种符箓手段，完全不知区区一张黄皮纸哪来这么大的力量封锁住他，想不通也理解不了。
重要的是他没有丝毫脱困的办法，想耍嘴皮子也只能发出呜呜声，压根说不出话来，而申尤昆却是越来越近了，月光下甚至能看到申尤昆面露的狰狞。
content_en:
Shi Chun also jumped up, drew his sword, and rushed forward quickly. The former's sword was too heavy, and he was chased by him in a short time.
The two people rushed out without any concealment, and the sound of the gravel they stepped on suddenly made the people in front of them turn back one after another.
Wu Jinliang's height and Wu Jinliang's sword were so obvious that even if he couldn't see his face clearly, Shen Youkun recognized who it was at a glance and couldn't help but exclaimed, "It's Shi Chun and Wu Jinliang, run, run!"
He was really panicking.
Was it those two people? Qi Ziru was also surprised. He originally thought that the two people had run away, but unexpectedly they were waiting for an opportunity under his nose. He probably guessed the intention of Shi Chun and others to take advantage of the opportunity to attack, and truly praised him from the bottom of his heart, "What a courage! What a method! How can you refuse to see guests when they come to visit? Stop the sedan chair and greet the guests."
The two bearers stopped running, turned around and got off the sedan, guarding the sides of the sedan.
The masked man also stopped and released the struggling Shen Youkun.
Shen Youkun was so frightened that he rolled down the hillside and scrambled to the ground to escape in panic. While running, he looked back from time to time, his face changed color with fear, and he obviously did not think that these few people here were Shi Chun's opponents.
Seeing that the target he was pursuing was waiting on the hillside, Shi Chun also noticed something was wrong. However, Shen Youkun was so frightened and ran away that it didn't look like an act. He immediately cleared up a lot of doubts. He huffed and puffed at full speed and rushed to his opponent. Taking advantage of the situation, he jumped up and struck the air with a knife. The cold light struck him in the air, ruthlessly and decisively!
Two bearers stood in front of Qi Ziru and prepared to fight, but the masked man waited quietly, ignoring Shi Chun's knife and staring at Wu Jinliang.
Wu Jinliang also rushed over, shouting excitedly, "Kill me!"
The sound of the sword swinging out was terrifying.
When he got closer, the masked man finally took action. With a shake of his hands, two yellow shadows popped up under the moonlight, one shot at Shi Chun and the other at Wu Jinliang.
Shi Chun's blade deflected in the air, intending to split the incoming object, but a dizziness suddenly appeared in front of his eyes.
What's going on? Secretly frightened, he urgently regained his composure and found that it was not dizziness, but a sense of distortion in the void in front of him. At the same time, he also felt that there was a force of stagnation enveloped in his body.
He found that his attack action of charging and slashing turned into slow motion, and the cutting blade was slowed down, and he missed the flying yellow shadow. At close range, he saw clearly that it was a yellow paper talisman with complex vermilion runes on it.
He lowered his eyes and watched the rune stick to his chest.
His movements were slow and he had no time to dodge. He vaguely felt an inexplicable force being released from the runes, and then he was unable to move.
The person did not fall to the ground, but was frozen in the air, still maintaining the slashing motion with the knife.
Although the person couldn't move, his mind was clear, and he instantly realized what was going on, the amulet!
I actually encountered the legendary amulet!
It was a legend to him. He had never seen it before. He only heard that there was such a thing in the outside world. He didn't expect that the group in front of him actually got this thing in.
At this moment, I feel regretful. I hate myself for being short-sighted. I don't even think about it. Is it difficult to get a talisman to bring in so many supplies? He ran away and then came back, isn't this someone who crashed into the door and is seeking death?
Thinking of being slapped by Shen Youkun's behavior of escaping, he was greeting Shen Youkun's ancestors in his heart.
However, it can also be seen from Shen Youkun who was so frightened that he ran away. This was definitely not Shen Youkun's handiwork. Shen Youkun might not even know that it was the work of the calm and calm man on the recliner.
Wu Jinliang behind him was motionless and was frozen there. There was a look of fear in his eyes and his mouth was still open. He clearly realized that he was really in trouble this time, and death was nothing. From the day he took the risk, he knew that this day would happen to him sooner or later, and he was afraid that he would be tortured and die badly.
He couldn't speak even if he wanted to, all he could say wasHe made an unclear "Woo" sound and wanted to ask Shi Chun what to do.
He knew that Shi Chun probably had no good solution, but at the moment, who else could he turn to besides Shi Chun to find a solution?
Shen Youkun, who looked back from time to time while escaping, stopped. After careful inspection, he seemed to understand something. No wonder his uncle said that he could not escape even at the high martial arts level. It turned out to be the case, so he ran back with a ferocious smile on his face.
Shi Chun saw this scene. He was frozen, but his eyes were not blind. He couldn't close his eyelids even if he wanted to, knowing full well that Shen Youkun would definitely take revenge.
He didn't want to fall into the hands of Shen Youkun, so he tried his best to fight with all his strength, trying to break free from the restraints. At first, he could shake some of the power that held him in place, but then it was as if he had been cast into steel. He didn't feel much oppression, but he couldn't shake it at all.
What's even more terrifying is that even the magic power of his body is frozen and cannot be used outside the body.
Even though he has been in the cultivation world for many years, the fights and killings he has experienced are just a battle of personal cultivation strength. When faced with this kind of talisman method, he has no idea how a piece of yellow paper can have such a powerful force to block him. He cannot figure it out or understand it.
The important thing is that he has no way to get out of trouble. He can only whine and can't speak at all if he wants to talk. But Shen Youkun is getting closer and closer, and you can even see the ferocious look on Shen Youkun's face under the moonlight.
